question: By whose agency does the speaker come to know the determination of Kaula, and to whom is that agency addressed?
premises: The address is to the lord of the Kaulas.
Knowledge arises by that lord's grace.
Through that grace the speaker has come to know the determination of Kaula.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of Kaula.
uncertainties: The extent of that determination is not specified here.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of Kaula.
